meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (corporate statutory framework modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law and U.S. corporate doctrines, overlaying Marshallese customary law and a unitary national common-law heritage; no sub-national corporate law distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (Title II economic relations and investment-related provisions)
World Trade Organization membership (accession 2001; general trade and services commitments under GATT and GATS)

No. 2012-13), as amended by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Amendment) Acts 2015, 2017 and 2019; Beneficial Ownership Regulations issued thereunder; Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended, 33 MIRC), including corporate name and registered agent provisions; Corporations (Amendment) Act 2014; Registrar of Corporations beneficial ownership register filing directives; Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directives implementing Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Recommendations.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, officers, and material funding sources against the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the UK OFSI Consolidated List, and domestic Marshall Islands FIU watchlists; enhanced due diligence (EDD) is statutorily required for foreign and domestic politically exposed persons (PEPs), their family members and close associates; continuous transaction monitoring, adverse-media review, and 25% UBO threshold verification apply; results must be documented and filed with the Financial Intelligence Unit as part of the pre-licensing AML/CFT compliance program.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands — electronic corporate name search and reservation system (accessible directly and through licensed registered agents authorized by the Registrar)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be composed in the Latin (Roman) alphabet; Marshallese-language names are permissible when transliterated into Roman script; names must be decipherable in English and indexed in a Roman-character form; the name must include a corporate designator such as 'Corporation,' 'Incorporated,' 'Limited,' 'Company' or an approved abbreviation (Corp., Inc., Ltd., Co.); non-Roman scripts (including Chinese, Cyrillic, and Arabic characters) are not accepted in the registered corporate name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection, the applicant must file a written Request for Reconsideration with the Registrar of Corporations within 21 calendar days, specifying grounds of distinctiveness, compliance with statutory naming rules, and, where applicable, evidence of a required ministerial or financial-services license; if the Registrar affirms the rejection, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the High Court of the Marshall Islands under the Administrative Procedure Act within 30 days; concurrently, the applicant may submit a revised corporate name for a new clearance and reservation cycle.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for the statutory registered office in the form of the licensed Registered Agent's physical address; a pure virtual office (mail-forwarding only without an agent relationship) is not acceptable. For the Equity Crowdfunding Portal (High-Risk Special License), the Registrar and the Financial Intelligence Unit expect demonstrable compliance substance — local agent oversight, AML/CFT compliance officer arrangements, and accessible books and records — although no dedicated bricks-and-mortar office is statutorily required at the incorporation stage.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (under 5% annual probability) during the dormant pre-licensing phase; moderately elevated once the crowdfunding license is issued — estimated 15% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by the Registrar or FIU during the first 12 months of operation, rising to approximately 40% annually after the portal begins holding escrowed investor funds.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), Republic of the Marshall Islands; ss. 20 (incorporation), 21 (filing and certificate), 22 (registered office and registered agent), 24 (bylaws), 26 (officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro, MH)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-1) submitted with the registered agent's written consent and the prescribed filing fee transmittal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; shares may be issued at US$0.01 par value or no par value, and no escrow or capital-attestation arrangement is required for a non-resident business corporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the issuance of 1,000 shares of common stock at US$0.01 par value to the sole initial subscriber be and is hereby ratified, and that officers be authorized to execute subscription agreements and share certificates. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation be fixed at the office of the registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that the registered agent is ratified as agent for service of process and official correspondence. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] as President and CEO, [Name] as Secretary and Compliance Officer, and [Name] as Treasurer be appointed to hold office until the next annual meeting, each with authority to open bank and escrow accounts, execute filings, and engage counsel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Search and Availability Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Reservation Desk, Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal name reservation request (Form BCA-NR1) through a licensed registered agent, specifying two alternative names to avoid conflict with existing Marshall Islands entities; pay the reservation fee by wire transfer; upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 days pending filing of the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of good standing of any parent entity (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is unavailable or confusingly similar to an existing entity, the registered agent refiles with the first alternative name within one business day; the applicant may also submit a written request for administrative review by the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent licensed by the Registrar of Corporations; notarization before a Marshall Islands Notary Public or consular officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in accordance with BCA ss. 20-22, stating the corporate name, authorized and issued share structure, specific purpose clauses authorizing operation of an equity crowdfunding portal, the registered office address in the Marshall Islands, the registered agent name, and the incorporator details. Execute the Articles before a notary; the registered agent countersigns to accept the agency appointment.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
Subscriber stockholder information and UBO declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries formatting or completeness, the registered agent corrects and re-notarizes the filing within five business days; a ministerial resubmission fee of US$50 applies for amended Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of Articles and Payment of State Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands (e-registry portal or physical filing window, Majuro)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar together with the official state filing fee of US$450; expedited same-day processing is available at an additional US$100; the registered agent submits the filing through the RMI Companies Registry online portal and obtains the stamped receipt.
required_dossiers: Cover letter summarizing requested corporate purpose and share structure
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a notice of deficiency, the agent cures the deficiency and refiles within ten business days; where the deficiency is ministerial, the original filing date is preserved; substantive defects require a fresh filing with revised fee and resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and First Board Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands; Board of Directors of the Corporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon endorsement of the Articles, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation; the incorporator convenes the First Board of Directors Meeting to adopt the Bylaws, approve the initial share subscription, ratify the registered agent and office, appoint the initial officers, and adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution.
required_dossiers: Subscription agreements and share certificate stubs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a clerical or legal error, file a Certificate of Correction under BCA s. 28 with the Registrar; no act done in good faith before correction is adversely affected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Financial Intermediary Licensing for Equity Crowdfunding Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, acting with the licensing recommendation of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the special license application for an equity crowdfunding portal, including the Certificate of Incorporation, evidence of registered agent, AML/CFT compliance program, structural description of the ACH and bank-wire escrow payment rails, platform operational rules, and directors' and officers' fitness-and-propriety declarations; undergo the Banking Commissioner's prudential review.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and registered agent confirmation
Business plan and platform governance rules
Escrow agent agreement for ACH and bank-wire rails
D&O and professional indemnity insurance certificates
Shareholder, director, and officer due-diligence forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the license application is queried or refused, submit supplementary compliance documentation within 20 business days; an appeal against the Banking Commissioner's decision may be lodged with the Minister of Finance within 30 days of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office Activation and Administrative Compliance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent for RMI statutory records; RMI Environmental Protection Authority; Fire and Civil Defense Authority; National Occupational Health and Safety Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the registered office at the agent's licensed address, post the statutory records and corporate seal, and file all mandatory administrative registrations: RMI EPA exemption self-assessment for digital operations, fire safety certification for the office premises, and OHS workplace clearance for any RMI-based employees.
required_dossiers: Registered office confirmation from the registered agent
RMI EPA exemption or registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any administrative registration is queried or expires, rectify the compliance gap within ten business days by resubmitting corrected forms or obtaining re-inspection; non-material omissions are subject to a formal cure notice before any penalty is assessed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Specialized Financial Intermediary Licensing Division)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Equity Crowdfunding Portal Special License (Non-Deposit-Taking Financial Intermediary Permit) with ACH and Bank-Wire Escrow Authorization

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: RMI Environmental Protection Authority (RMIEPA), established under the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Act 1987
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Exempt (low-impact, purely digital office operations with no industrial discharge); a Simple Environmental Registration may be required if a physical server hosting or office facility above 200 m2 is established
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial effluent discharge; no VOC or combustion emissions; electronic waste handling per RMIEPA Waste Disposal Standard 2012; any cooling-water discharge from a server room is capped at 1 m3/day with pH 6.5-8.5 and temperature delta below 5 degrees Celsius; no air emissions permit required for platform operations

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Compliance Certificate issued by the RMI Fire and Civil Defense Authority covering the registered office and any RMI-based operations; annual electrical and structural load inspection for office premises; Occupational Health and Safety workplace clearance under the RMI OHS Regulations, including emergency evacuation plan, first-aid readiness, and workstation ergonomic compliance

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services (no public e-filing portal; filings are coordinated through registered agents and the RMI Registrar of Corporations)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident Business Corporations in the Marshall Islands are generally exempt from domestic income tax and are not required to obtain a tax identification number for income tax purposes. If a company creates a domestic taxable nexus through local-source activities or engages RMI employees, it must apply to the Revenue and Taxation Division for a TIN using Form TIN-01, attaching the certificate of incorporation, registered agent confirmation, and beneficial ownership declaration. Because the RMI has no VAT, there is no separate VAT identifier.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Entity classification is fixed by the Associations Law at formation; the RMI does not operate a check-the-box regime or recognize hybrid mismatch elections. Non-resident Business Corporations are automatically tax-exempt unless they carry on trade or business within the Republic of the Marshall Islands, in which case statutory corporate income tax applies by operation of law rather than by election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (No VAT/GST/Retail Sales Tax; customs import duty and excise taxes apply at the border)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. Imports are subject to customs duty; an importer must be registered with the RMI Customs Service under its customs business identifier, regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping regime exists in the Marshall Islands. Invoices are not tax-cleared by the Revenue and Taxation Division; however, export invoices must satisfy customs documentary standards and the Crowdfunding Portal licensee must retain commercial documentation for AML/CFT examination.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands imposes no VAT, so there is no 0% export VAT rate, no input VAT credit, and no VAT refund mechanism. Goods and offshore services supplied by a non-resident Business Corporation are outside the scope of any RMI indirect tax, provided they do not constitute imports into the RMI customs territory.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Inward Remittance Certificate or supporting FX receipts
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback regime exists because no VAT is assessed. Fraudulent customs declarations or misuse of duty-exempt export procedures expose the declarant to cargo seizure, forfeiture, retrospective duty assessments, monetary penalties under the Customs Tariff legislation, and criminal liability for customs evasion; serious violations may also trigger suspension or revocation of the Crowdfunding Portal's special license for material compliance failure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not maintain an indigenous central bank and has adopted the United States dollar as its sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association and the RMI Monetary System Act. The sovereign monetary and currency administration function is therefore exercised de facto by the U.S. Federal Reserve System, while domestic banking licensing, prudential oversight, and foreign-exchange-related regulatory conduct are administered by the Marshall Islands Banking Commission, located within the Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services, with AML/CFT surveillance carried out by the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). No separate central-bank exchange-control department exists in the RMI.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de jure and de facto convertibility prevails. Because the RMI is fully dollarized, the distinction between capital-account and current-account convertibility is legally moot: there is no national currency, no central-bank reserve constraint, and no statutory exchange-control mechanism requiring approval of cross-border transfers or profit remittances. Dividends, royalties, license fees, and loan-service payments may be remitted offshore without prior licensing or conversion restrictions. Practical frictions are confined to non-statutory factors, principally correspondent-bank de-risking, OFAC screening, FIU threshold reporting, and investor-funds segregation compliance. The entity should therefore maintain all treasury liquidity in USD, hold a valid Migratory or Non-Resident Corporation Certificate of Good Standing, and structure upstream receivables into USD to avoid jurisdiction-level withholding at the payor source.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory obligations: nil. The RMI imposes no surrender, conversion, repatriation-timeline, or concentration-ratio requirements for export proceeds, subscription proceeds, or any other foreign receipts. Foreign-currency account balances may be retained indefinitely with no forced conversion. The only applicable duties are ordinary record-keeping, FIU suspicious-transaction reporting at statutory thresholds, and the general prohibition against structuring transactions to evade reporting. For the crowdfunding portal, all escrow receipts must be attributable to identified investors with documented source-of-funds trails; however, no mandatory conversion timeline applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (segregated USD escrow and subscription collection facility)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Marshall Islands (BOMI) Treasury and Operations Desk
Bank of Guam (Pacific regional licensed bank with correspondent entry into the RMI market)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Settlement Clearing and Escrow Mirror Account (USD)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium with restrictive legal conditions. The RMI does not issue electronic-money-institution (EMI) licenses; an offshore digital EMI chartered under FCA, EU/EEA, or Canadian MSB laws cannot itself function as the primary escrow vault for a non-resident RMI crowdfunding portal. Such an EMI may serve only as a pass-through settlement mechanism when paired with an RMI-compliant licensed bank or a U.S. state-licensed money transmitter or chartered trust company holding bankruptcy-remote escrow. Legal constraints include: the absence of reciprocal RMI recognition of foreign EMI authorisations; the inability of an offshore EMI to establish a U.S. Federal Reserve master account without a U.S. physical nexus and Employer Identification Number; and the high likelihood that EMIs will decline the Crowdfunding_Portal AML classification or impose low balances, tight daily caps, and strict velocity limits.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical-presence KYC is the default standard for a non-resident RMI Business Corporation. Directors, beneficial owners, and the designated AML compliance officer must generally attend an in-person interview at BOMI's Majuro branch or before a recognised RMI Consulate, honorary consul, or the registered-agent office acting as an identity notary. Remote opening is not a statutory entitlement and is granted only exceptionally, subject to enhanced video-KYC, apostilled corporate documentation, and registered-agent attestation. At least one director with actual signatory authority must appear in person; after the interview, the remainder of the board may be onboarded remotely on the strength of the completed first interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High_Risk_Special_License and unproven Crowdfunding_Portal underwriting model; bank perceives unlicensed deposit-taking or pooled-fund vulnerability under the RMI AML/CFT Act 2024 section 12(e).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the statutory crowdfunding license and Registrar of Corporations Certificate of Good Standing; escrow-agent agreement demonstrating execution-only pass-through with no deposit-taking; legal opinion confirming the portal is not engaged in banking business; audited statement of escrow segregation; board resolution expressly prohibiting interest-bearing or deposit-like treatment of investor funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt shell profile with minimal substance, suggesting tax avoidance or jurisdiction-shopping rather than genuine operation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI Certificate of Non-Resident Status or Migratory Entity Certificate; substance dossier including registered office lease, registered-agent agreement, resident director appointment minutes, and organizational chart; consolidated audited financial statements; board resolutions authorising account opening; Charter and Bylaws with a clearly defined Crowdfunding_Portal object clause.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Risk of commingling retail investor subscription funds with platform operating capital, and consequent investor-protection deficiency.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Flow-of-funds schematic; investor-level sub-ledger accounting; executed third-party fiduciary escrow or trust agreement; dual-control treasury policy; independent auditor's report (SOC 1 Type II equivalent) confirming segregation of customer balances; live treasury-system reporting delivered to the bank at onboarding and quarterly thereafter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border retail investor UBO opacity and heterogeneous small-ticket inbound wires; incomplete FATF Recommendation 10 source-of-funds records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investor-level KYC and self-certification pack; accredited-investor records under applicable exemptions; source-of-wealth declarations for all persons subscribing above EUR 10,000-equivalent or holding more than 2% of a funding round; automated sanctions and PEP screening logs; FIU threshold-report evidence; ongoing transaction-monitoring and escalation procedure described in the AML manual.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Instant-outflow treasury risk: fast disbursements to unvetted portfolio companies may create fraud and layering channels.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written disbursement and positive-pay policy; portfolio-company KYB checklist with legal-entity identifiers and ultimate-beneficial-ownership verification; two-person approval and multi-factor authorisation protocol; immutable audit log generated by the payment engine; quarterly independent verification of outbound wires against the recorded investment agreements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Investor subscriptions flow through one of two compliant corridors: (a) domestic ACH collection into a licensed U.S. trust-company escrow account followed by a bank-wire sweep to the RMI entity's BOMI capital escrow account; or (b) direct SWIFT MT103 wires from investor banks in the investor jurisdiction. All instructions must state: beneficiary bank as Bank of Marshall Islands, Majuro, with its U.S. correspondent clearings; purpose code 'IP — Investment Purposes / Equity Subscription'; and a beneficiary sub-account reference containing the portal offering code in field 59 narrative to enable automated reconciliation. The entity must respond to any correspondent request letter with the board resolution, the licence certificate, the escrow agreement, and the investor attestation bundle. Cash, bearer instruments, and third-party funding are prohibited except upon express contractual novation. All funds above USD 10,000 trigger FIU-equivalent threshold reporting on the RMI-compliant basis.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operating disbursements, refunds, regulatory fees, and portfolio-advance settlement run on SWIFT MT103 via the BOMI U.S. correspondent network, or on Fedwire for same-day finality when required. For trade-finance settlements, an at-sight irrevocable commercial letter of credit issued by a prime bank may be used where the platform is applicant and the portfolio vendor is beneficiary; however, the LC is suboptimal for services, refunds, and regulatory filings because it requires shipment-linked document presentation. Every outbound debit must carry an OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening token, the underlying investor or offering reference, and a pre-authorised positive-pay instruction. Refunds are executed strictly as reversal wires to the original funding account for the identical round-trip sum.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright FX forwards (plain-vanilla, non-leveraged) with pre-approved OECD bank counterparties under an ISDA FX Annex.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) limited strictly to genuinely non-convertible emerging-market currency exposures referenced to the offshore USD fixing.
Plain-vanilla cross-currency swaps (fixed-to-floating or floating-to-floating, optional principal exchange) with no embedded leverage and full ISDA documentation.
Vanilla FX options purchased only; writing or shorting of options is prohibited by the treasury policy tier.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Business Corporation (Non-Resident) filed under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (34 MIRC Ch. 1) and the Non-Resident Domestic Corporations Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands (administered through the Marshall Islands Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar compliance window from 1 January to 30 April of each year; the deadline is fixed by calendar year, not by the anniversary of incorporation, and applies uniformly to all entities regardless of incorporation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: USD 100 late-filing penalty assessed for each month or part of a month after 30 April; continuous non-filing for one full year authorizes the Registrar to strike off or administratively dissolve the corporation; reinstatement requires payment of all accumulated penalties and a restoration fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the regulated equity crowdfunding portal license, comprising the annual audited financial statements, the updated beneficial-ownership declaration, and the annual compliance certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Banking Commissioner / Financial Services Regulator, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal application due no later than 90 days before the annual anniversary of the original license issuance; audited financial statements must be submitted within 120 days after the licensee's fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic administrative suspension of the crowdfunding license upon expiry; additional monetary penalty accruing for each day of delinquency as prescribed by the licensing statute; license revocation and mandatory cessation of portal operations if renewal remains delinquent for 60 days

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: The Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act imposes no general statutory audit requirement on non-resident business corporations; a mandatory independent annual audit is triggered solely by the regulated equity crowdfunding portal license, whose conditions require audited financial statements without regard to revenue, asset, or shareholding thresholds
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB and adopted in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, or US GAAP at the election of the directors; books and records must be maintained at the registered office or the registered agent's office and need not be filed with the Registrar of Corporations unless the regulated-license conditions require filing with the financial regulator

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent circulates the annual report together with a current beneficial-ownership confirmation for execution by the directors and officers; all share transfers completed during the preceding year must be recorded in the register of members before the annual report is submitted; the Registrar may demand beneficial-ownership disclosure in writing, and an outdated ownership record may cause rejection of the annual report and exposure to late penalties
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholder and Director Resolutions
Registered Office Address and Registered Agent Consent Record

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 – USD 1,500 per annum for a standard Marshall Islands registered agent and registered office package, excluding disbursements and license-specific compliance services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 10,000 – USD 28,000 per annum for a small-to-mid-scale regulated equity crowdfunding portal subject to a full IFRS or US GAAP independent audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Complete statutory exemption: a non-resident Business Corporation (BC) organized under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act is subject to zero corporate income tax, zero capital gains tax, and zero gross revenue tax. No tax holiday or preferential deduction is required because the exemption is absolute for a BC that does not carry on business, maintain an office, or hold property in the Republic of the Marshall Islands. The only recurring State charge is the fixed annual government fee calculated on authorized capital, paid together with the annual report. Statutory loss carryforward is inapplicable under a zero-tax regime; the 5-year figure is populated per schema convention only.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 7 (Annual Report, Domestic Stock Corporation) filed with the Registrar of Corporations through the licensed RMI registered agent or the RMI Business Registry e-filing portal; the Marshall Islands does not administer a corporate income tax return for non-resident BCs.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Initial annual report due within 60 days after the date of incorporation; each subsequent annual report due on or before the anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year, with the annual government fee payable concurrently.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporate name as recorded in the Articles of Incorporation; must not be confusingly similar to a name reserved for a licensed registered agent or a regulated financial institution.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the full statutory name of the BC; do not append an unregistered fictitious trade name. Any portal brand name must be separately protected in the operating jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 2 - Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and physical address in the Republic of the Marshall Islands of the licensed resident agent serving as the statutory service point for legal process.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must hold a valid Marshall Islands registered-agent or trust-company license; the BC may not act as its own agent and may maintain no other RMI office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the entity's main operational office where books and records are kept and where management decisions are executed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident BC, enter the actual operational address of the equity crowdfunding portal located outside the RMI; a P.O. box is not acceptable and the address must corroborate non-resident status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and residential addresses of all directors (minimum one) and, at the election of the member, names of principal officers such as president, secretary, and treasurer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No RMI residency requirement applies; directors may be natural persons or legal entities located anywhere. Do not list the RMI registered agent as a director for a non-resident BC, because doing so may support a finding of RMI management and control.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, aggregate par value, and class breakdown of the capital structure; this line fixes the tier of the annual government fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Calculate the fee tier accurately from the authorized capital declared in the Articles of Incorporation; deliberately understating authorized capital to reduce the government fee is a false filing, not a tax-planning measure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 6 - Non-Resident Exemption Declaration and Signature
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the corporation has not carried on business, maintained an office, or held real property in the Republic of the Marshall Islands during the reporting period; executed by a director or authorized officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory for every non-resident BC. A false certification exposes the entity to retroactive loss of exempt status, administrative strike-off, statutory penalties, and personal liability of the signatory.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a monthly delinquency surcharge per the Registrar's published fee schedule, compounding until the report is accepted; continued default triggers administrative dissolution and striking-off under the Business Corporations Act, forfeiture of good standing, and reinstatement costs of up to three times the overdue annual fee. Directors are additionally exposed to personal liability for filings made or omitted during their tenure.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the Marshall Islands imposes no domestic withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation, whether to residents or non-residents.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No DTA relief application or tax-residency certificate is required because the statutory withholding rate is already zero. The RMI Registrar issues Certificate of Exemption and Certificate of Good Standing instruments for non-resident BCs; it does not issue treasury-based tax-residency certificates to fully tax-exempt non-resident entities. The limited US-RMI income tax convention covers only shipping and aircraft operations and grants no portfolio-dividend relief, so a foreign withholding agent must apply the operating jurisdiction's domestic rate where the distribution is otherwise sourced.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 0% on cross-border interest and intellectual-property royalties paid by an RMI BC. No treaty rate reduction is available or necessary. The RMI's OECD Inclusive Framework commitments do not modify the zero statutory rate, but the payor jurisdiction may independently tax the underlying income under its domestic source rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None in the RMI: domestic law imposes no Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country Reporting filing thresholds (USD or otherwise) on non-resident BCs. An MNE group exceeding the EUR 750 million BEPS consolidated-revenue threshold is reportable only through the RMI-facilitated automatic exchange of information, not through any local filing obligation. Transfer pricing on the portal's intercompany service fees, escrow margins, and technology royalty flows is therefore governed by the operating jurisdiction where the crowdfunding business is tax resident.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has not enacted BVI/Cayman-style Economic Substance Regulations for non-resident BCs. Practical substance standards follow OECD Inclusive Framework expectations: an exempt RMI BC must maintain the statutory non-resident indicia — no RMI business, no RMI property, and no RMI-resident management or board meetings. For a high-risk ISIC 6499 equity crowdfunding business, the operating license, physical staff, board decision-making, escrow governance, KYC/AML controls, and audit trail must reside in the regulated market jurisdiction. An RMI BC retaining only a registered agent and no demonstrable activity is presumptively a shell and is the primary target of foreign anti-avoidance recharacterization.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Offshore Abusive Structure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deploying the tax-exempt RMI BC as a nominee or opaque layer to conceal beneficial ownership of crowdfunding equity stakes, disguise taxable gains of US or EU resident investors and issuers, or knowingly filing a false non-resident exemption declaration while operating RMI-sourced business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of exempt status, retrospective tax assessment, criminal fines and confiscation orders under RMI financial-crime provisions, referral to the RMI Banking Commissioner and Financial Intelligence Unit, and in the operating jurisdiction tax-fraud penalties of up to 75% of the understated tax with criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts pierce the corporate veil for sham nominee structures and impose joint and several liability for taxes, interest, and penalties on each director and controlling shareholder; asset-freeze orders, travel bans, and custodial sentences of up to 10 years apply for fraud and false declaration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a mailbox BC with no employees, no physical office, and no board governance while the portal originates retail securities transactions and passes investor funds through unlicensed or commingled escrow arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative strike-off by the Registrar for annual-report default, judicial dissolution, and loss of legal personality; foreign tax authorities may disregard the entity entirely and impose entity-level taxation on all portal revenue, or treat the portal as a permanent establishment of the foreign parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal exposure for unauthorized securities intermediation, civil restraint orders over personal assets, travel bans pending regulatory inquiry, and foreign director-disqualification orders for operating an unlicensed portal.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach and Unlicensed Crowdfunding Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a high-risk equity crowdfunding intermediary without the required securities and AML license in the market jurisdiction; using ACH escrow or bank-wire rails to launder proceeds; failing to perform KYC and beneficial-ownership verification of issuers and investors; absence of an appointed AML compliance officer and suspicious-transaction reporting protocol.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines per violation and revocation of the registered agent's license under the RMI Banking Act and AML/CFT Regulations, criminal conviction for unlicensed securities dealing, mandatory referral to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, and FATF-linked countermeasures that may terminate correspondent banking access.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the designated AML compliance officer are personally and criminally liable for willful breaches; sanctions include imprisonment up to 5 years per offense, extradition under mutual legal assistance treaties, travel bans, personal fines, and permanent disqualification from holding directorships in licensed entities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Filings and Fraud on the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false or materially incomplete annual reports (Form 7), misrepresenting the authorized capital schedule to reduce the annual government fee, or concealing the ultimate beneficial owner of the crowdfunding portal from the registered agent and regulatory authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporation-level penalty of up to USD 5,000 plus daily default fines under the Business Corporations Act; the Registrar may revoke the certificate, refuse reinstatement, void statutory filings, and remove the entity from good-standing registers relied on by financial counterparties and regulators.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director or officer who signed or authorized the false report is jointly and severally liable for the penalty; the RMI High Court may impose imprisonment of up to 2 years for perjury or false declaration and issue travel bans pending full restitution to affected investors or creditors.
